name: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura

dinnerNoteIt: Menu degustazione Journey to Tuscany (con i vini €290)

lunchNoteIt: Stesso menu a pranzo (oppure singoli piatti alla carta da €40)

menus.name: Journey to Tuscany tasting menu
menus.note: For the whole table; €290 as the Sommelier Experience with wine; the restaurant's pappardella can be added for €40 and caviar for €25 a dish

alsoTry.name: Gucci Giardino 25
alsoTry.note: The Gucci café and cocktail bar in the same palazzo on Piazza della Signoria, open from breakfast through light lunches, afternoon tea and cocktails

bookingOpens: Through the reservation page on the restaurant's website, by phone or by email (gucciosteria.mb@gucci.com).
groups: Gucci Osteria and Gucci Giardino cater private events and special occasions; ask through the contact page.
